value.answer: Call 911 now - this needs emergency care right now. A toddler who is floppy, hard to wake, with sunken eyes and no wet diaper in 12 hours is showing serious signs that need a hospital.
value.triage: Call 911 now, or go straight to the ER if you can get there faster. Do not wait and watch, and do not call 811 first - 811 is the nurse line for non-urgent advice. Tell them about the 2 days of vomiting and diarrhea.
